_comment: Pluggable agent-runtime registry (Phase 6 — PAI integration). Defines the governed coding-agent backends the fleet can launch via agentctl / agent-job. One source of truth so adding a runtime is data, not code. Deployed to /opt/agent-os/runtimes.json; validate with `pai-runtimes validate`. Every runtime inherits the PreToolUse guardrail and the per-UNIX-user sandbox — a runtime entry CANNOT opt out of the gate. `gateway_routed` runtimes have their base URL pointed at the shared MultiLLM gateway so usage is tracked per tenant.

runtimes.name: antigravity
runtimes.description: Google Antigravity CLI (AGY) — the Google-family runtime, REPLACES the Gemini CLI. Binary 'agy'. Install: download https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh, review, then run it (the Ansible PAI task does this via get_url + execute). Headless: agy -p "<prompt>" (add --output-format json for structured output). Docs: https://antigravity.google/docs/cli-using

runtimes.name: hermes
runtimes.description: Nous Research Hermes agent. Binary 'hermes'. Headless one-shot: 'hermes -z "<prompt>"' (final answer only). Config ~/.hermes/{.env,SOUL.md,config.yaml} (chmod 600). Gateway routing via OPENAI_BASE_URL. Install: download github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent install.sh, review, run (--skip-browser headless). Docs: hermes-agent.nousresearch.com

runtimes.name: nanoclaw
runtimes.description: Lightweight nano-claw / OpenClaw agent. Command path is a placeholder until the principal supplies the exact binary/flags.

runtimes.name: pi
runtimes.description: Pi coding agent (earendil-works) — self-extensible TS agent with read/write/edit/bash tools, JSONL session tree, multi-provider via pi-ai. Binary 'pi'. Headless: pi -p "<prompt>" (print mode; also reads piped stdin). JSON: pi --mode json. Provider/model: --provider/--model. Install: npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (needs Node >=22.19). Gateway routing via OPENAI_BASE_URL (pi-ai honors OpenAI-compatible base URLs). Docs: github.com/earendil-works/pi. NOTE: pi ships NO sandboxing — run inside the devvm guardrail/per-tenant sandbox (its missing safety is exactly what this fleet provides).
